title: Teamspace | Modules added under a folder appear in the left pane as Root modules until saved; deleting a folder with modules doesn't ask what to do with them
env: staging-crm.taviportal.com · tenant NDC-Staging · Edge (headless) · account mahmoud.mahamed1515 (CRM Admin); test user 1 / test user 2 where noted

panels.caption: On an existing teamspace, Add Modules (leads → Folder B) links at once: "Modules linked successfully" — no unsaved state.
Left pane right after: no "Leads" flat at the root — it is nested under QA RT Folder B.
Delete Folder B: states "has 2 modules", offers Move (folder picker) or Remove, button "Move & Delete".
Move to Root → folder deleted, "Teamspace updated successfully"; QA RT TS still has its 4 modules (tasks, leads now at root).

rows: Left pane before / after adding to a folder
Add Modules links immediately ("Modules linked successfully"); sidebar nests leads under Folder B — never shown flat at root
Dialog states the number of modules
"The "QA RT Folder B" folder has 2 modules."
Choice: move (folder / root) or remove; button names the outcome
"Move modules and delete folder" (Root / QA RT Folder A2) or "Remove modules and delete folder"; "Move & Delete"
Folder deleted; tasks and leads at root; 4 modules kept
